why: CI must be able to say WHICH spec ran, not only that the suite finished.
Every spec named here MUST have executed (not skipped) in the run. If one did not, the E2E job fails and names it.
Add a spec here the moment its silent skip would cost us something we cannot afford to lose quietly: tenant isolation, auth, money paths.
Remove one only with a reason in the PR body. A spec quietly dropped from this list is the same hole this list closes.
